brand.logo_policy: No logo supplied; preserve the branded palette and safe zones.
brand.image_treatment: No imagery; structured evidence is rendered as native editable objects.
brand.icon_style: No icons; restrained geometric marks only.

composition.shadow_policy: No shadows unless foreground hierarchy requires one.
composition.accent_policy: Teal for structure, gold for metrics, coral for risk.
composition.whitespace_policy: Separate claim, evidence, and implication with explicit zones.
